info.title: Floopel Backend — console-partner surface (living contract)
info.description:
LIVING per-surface OpenAPI 3.1 contract for the Floopel **console-partner** surface (server `/api/console-partner/v1`, ADR-0004).

This is a GENERATED, LIVING document: it is reconciled against the live router (`backend/internal/adapter/http/router.go` — the ground truth for which routes exist) and harvests request/response/schema shapes from the per-PRD contracts under `document/prd/**/openapi.json` (the per-feature source of truth). It MUST be updated in the SAME PR as any route, contract, or data-model change (CLAUDE.md §3.2 change-triggers; .claude/rules/golang.md). If a route below carries a LIVING-CONTRACT PLACEHOLDER, the router has it but the per-PRD spec did not define its shape yet.

Shared platform components (Envelope/Meta/ErrorBody, the standard 4xx responses, and common parameters) are unified to ONE canonical definition per surface — Meta matches the Go `pkg/response` type (incl. optional pagination) and the error schema is ErrorBody. Security schemes are unified by cookie name. Path param names follow the router (ground truth). NOTE: the partner console is a SCAFFOLD — only `GET /auth/csrf` is live in router.go today (it mounts CSRF-issue + a stateful-authed subgroup pending its own login/feature slices). This contract will grow as those slices land.

Metadata request klien: aplikasi yang diperbarui mengirim X-App-Version dari versi build dan X-App-Platform bernilai ANDROID, IOS atau WEB pada seluruh operasi API, termasuk upload dan probe maintenance. Header ini deskriptif, bukan attestation atau otorisasi. Server tetap menerima klien lama tanpa versi; tidak ada gate minimum versi. Endpoint identitas native tetap mensyaratkan platform ANDROID/IOS sesuai parameter dan credential channel existing; WEB tidak diterima pada endpoint tersebut.

get.description: Sets the double-submit CSRF cookie and returns the token for the console-partner surface (ADR-0011 R8). Call before any state-changing request.
